purpose: Deny having intended or regarded a past action in a certain way.
keywords: talk about time sequence duration habits
express wishes wants obligation permission request advice
I did not mean to blame you.
I do not consider myself to have forgotten the promise.
I was not trying to make a joke.
restrictions: Common when the listener interprets an action differently.
mistake: It denies intention or self-assessment, not necessarily the observable act.
